NEW one cannot be added quietly. The party that writes the guards is the
party the guards exist to stop: CWD_DRIFT_OK was not inherited -- a Claude
session wrote it, printed it in its own refusal, and a later session read
NOTHING HERE IS ENDORSED BY BEING LISTED. 'judged' is where that is
recorded, and every entry is pending until Patrick rules. This file is the
CE-12 epic's work list, not its conclusion.

_fields.judged: pending until Patrick rules; nothing is approved by appearing here
_fields.advertise: may the guard print this token in agent-readable output? AC3 says no for anything judged; false is enforced by hatch_authoring_guard

launch_shell_env: Read with os.environ FROM THE HOOK PROCESS. An agent cannot set it: a
`VAR=1 <cmd>` prefix sets the environment of the command bash runs, not
of the hook that judged it, and shell state does not survive between
tool calls. Only the launching shell can. This is the shape the shared
command_text_token: Matched against command text or a file being written. AN AGENT TYPES
THIS. Every one is an agent-usable hatch, which zero-trust forbids.
not_a_hatch: Matched the token shape but grants nothing.
structural_exemption: Not a token at all. A property of the WORK -- its type -- that turns a
gate off. The inventory's first pass scanned source for token strings
and missed these entirely, which is why the most powerful hatch in the
system was absent from the list of hatches.
The agent picks the type. Patrick, 2026-09-13: 'that would mean that
actual features get filed under a bullshit flag' -- and on 2026-09-12/13
nine substantial guard changes were filed as chores by me, unknowingly,
which is exactly the smuggling the code's own comment warns about.

command_text_token.judged: 2026-09-13: stop advertising it. The mechanism stands pending Patrick's ruling; printing it does not.
why: This refusal did both things CE-12.2 exists to stop, in one message.
It handed the reader the exact inline token that turns it off -- the
CWD_DRIFT_OK shape. And it instructed 'park it, then re-run the
discard command' while never reading refs/parked/, so a session that
followed the instruction got the identical refusal and the only real
exit was the token it had just been shown. A refusal that lies about
the sanctioned path and then advertises the unsanctioned one is how
an agent learns to reach for hatches.

structural_exemption.effect: skips the QA rationale, the QA round, and every verified_by check
skips verified_by; a report's criteria are prose for a human
skips verified_by; an epic carries no code of its own
skips verified_by; gated by CSO at the release head instead
